hypotheses.construction_plan: Instantiate the generic second factor f in K(n)*f(n) as a or b, then sum the two instances to reconstruct the raw expression.
required_assumptions: K, a, and b are unary functions of n with compatible domains.
hypotheses.rationale: Both summands share the identical factor K(n), so they can be viewed as two specializations of a single product template with a generic second factor.
